Ex: I have a meeting with my supervisor about my research topic.

directory

(noun). danh bạ

Ex: She decided to check the business directory for the address.

suitable

(adjective). Phù hợp

Ex: This programme is not suitable for children.

scan

(verb). quét qua

Ex: Doug scanned the horizon for any sign of the boat.

reschedule

(verb). dời lịch

Ex: The meeting has been rescheduled for next week.

simply

(adverb). chỉ là, chỉ

Ex: This is not to suggest we simply ignore the problem.

option

(noun). Phương án, sự lựa chọn

Ex: We are currently studying all the options available.

transfer

(verb). chuyển máy

Ex: I'll just transfer you to customer service.

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

schedule

(noun). lịch trình, thời gian biểu

Ex: They have a very flexible work schedule.

imply

(verb). ám chỉ

Ex: I never meant to imply any criticism.

automatically

(adverb). một cách tự động

Ex: I automatically put my hand out to catch the ball.

aisle

(noun). lối đi

Ex: Coffee and tea are in the next aisle.

allow

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This research must be allowed to continue.

apply

(verb). xin

Ex: I have decided to apply for this new job.

arrange

(verb). sắp xếp

Ex: The books are arranged alphabetically by author.

assistance

(noun). Sự hỗ trợ

Ex: He can only walk with the assistance of crutches.

backward

(adjective). chậm tiến, lạc hậu

Ex: When he was a child, his teachers thought he was backward.

brand

(noun). nhãn hiệu

Ex: We compared our product with the leading brands.

browse through

(verb). xem qua

Ex: I was browsing through fashion magazines to find a new hairstyle.

concept

(noun). khái niệm, ý tưởng

Ex: the concept that everyone should have equality of opportunity

contain

(verb). Chứa đựng, bao gồm

Ex: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.

contribute

(verb). đóng góp

Ex: We contributed £5 000 to the earthquake fund.

deliberately

(adverb). cố ý, chủ tâm

Ex: She's been deliberately ignoring him all day.

delicate

(adjective). tinh tế

Ex: We chose a delicate floral pattern for our bedroom curtains.

display

(verb). Trưng bày

Ex: She proudly displayed her certificate to her parents.

force

(verb). bắt buộc

Ex: I was forced to take a taxi because the last bus had left.

fortunately

(adverb). may thay, may mắn

Ex: The documents fortunately survived the fire.

immediately

(adverb). ngay lập tức

Ex: They immediately began arguing.

impulse buying

(noun). sự mua sắm tuỳ hứng

Ex: They display chocolates next to supermarket checkouts to encourage impulse buying.

in advance

(adverb). trước

Ex: People were evacuated from the coastal regions in advance of the hurricane.

inefficient

(adjective). không có hiệu quả

Ex: The boss thinks the new secretary is inefficient.

intend

(verb). Dự định

Ex: The train we had intended to catch had already left.

invent

(verb). Phát minh

Ex: Who invented the steam engine?

optimistic

(adjective). lạc quan

Ex: We are now taking a more optimistic view.

patent

(noun). bằng sáng chế

Ex: The device was protected by patent.

phenomenon

(noun). hiện tượng

Ex: Globalization is a phenomenon of the 21st century.

purchase

(noun). sự mua, vật mua được

Ex: If you are not satisfied with your purchase, we will give you a full refund.

revolution

(noun). cuộc cách mạng

Ex: A revolution in information technology is taking place.

select

(verb). chọn lọc

Ex: He hasn't been selected for the team.

significantly

(adverb). 1 cách đáng kể

Ex: Profits have increased significantly over the past few years.

simultaneously

(adverb). Đồng thời

Ex: The game will be broadcast simultaneously on TV and radio.

smooth

(adjective). trơn tru, suôn sẻ

Ex: They could not ensure a smooth transfer of political power.

soar

(verb). tăng vụt

Ex: Unemployment has soared to 18 per cent.

time-consuming

(adjective). tốn nhiều thời gian

Ex: It’s quite time-consuming having to check all the labels individually.

unimaginable

(adjective). không thể tưởng tượng được

Ex: This level of success would have been unimaginable just last year.

unnecessary

(adjective). không cần thiết

Ex: Don't take any unnecessary risks.

wander

(verb). Lang thang

Ex: We spent the morning wandering around the old part of the city.

accommodate

(verb). chứa được, đựng được

Ex: The garage can accommodate three cars.

layout

(noun). Cách bố trí

Ex: There is no single correct layout for business letters.

divide

(verb). Phân chia

Ex: The questions divide into two categories: easy and hard.

maintain

(verb). duy trì

Ex: The two countries have always maintained close relations.

section

(noun). khu, khu vực

Ex: The library has a large biology section.

expense

(noun). phí tổn, chi phí

Ex: The garden was transformed at great expense.

labour

(noun). lao động chân tay

Ex: Companies are making huge profits by exploiting cheap labour in poor countries.

major

(adjective). chủ yếu, quan trọng

Ex: He played a major role in setting up the system.

operate

(verb). Vận hành

Ex: Solar panels can only operate in sunlight.

previous

(adjective). trước

Ex: No previous experience is necessary for this job.

reference

(noun). sự nói đến, sự nhắc đến

Ex: She made no reference to her illness but only to her future plans.

carry out

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.

cooperative

(noun). cửa hàng hợp tác xã

Ex: The family business is now run as a cooperative.

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

Ex: Let’s establish some ground rules.

perspective

(noun). Góc nhìn

Ex: A historical perspective may help us understand the issue.

put into practice

(verb). thực hành, đem áp dụng vào thực tiễn

Ex: Her advice is good, but it's hard to put into practice.

wholesale

(adjective). bán buôn, bán sỉ

Ex: "It was purchased at wholesale price," the senator said.

comprehensive

(adjective). Bao quát, toàn diện

Ex: You are advised to take out comprehensive insurance.

counter

(noun). quầy

Ex: I asked the woman behind the counter if they had any postcards.

delivery

(noun). sự giao hàng

Ex: We have invested to improve service delivery.

offer

(verb). Cung cấp

Ex: The hotel offers excellent facilities for families.

purpose

(noun). mục đích

Ex: Our campaign's main purpose is to raise money.

branch

(noun). chi nhánh

Ex: Our New York branch is dealing with the matter.

description

(noun). Sự miêu tả, sự mô tả

Ex: The name means ‘no trees’ and it is an accurate description of the island.

franchise

(verb). nhượng quyền thương mại

Ex: It takes hundreds of thousands of dollars to get into the franchised pizza business.

retailer

(noun). Nhà bán lẻ

Ex: High street retailers reported a marked increase in sales before Christmas.

clerk

(noun). nhân viên bán hàng

Ex: The sales clerk answered all our questions.

grocery store

(noun). cửa hàng bách hóa

Ex: In Canadian retail grocery stores, more space is devoted to fresh produce than to any other food sector.

checkout

(noun). quầy thanh toán

Ex: You can’t just go through the checkout without paying!

entrance

(noun). Lối vào

Ex: A separate entrance leads to the garden.

exit

(noun). lối ra

Ex: There is a fire exit on each floor of the building.

serve

(verb). dùng cho, đảm nhiệm

Ex: The sofa will serve as a bed for a night or two.

goods

(noun). hàng hóa

Ex: The goods will be delivered within ten days.

disturb

(verb). làm nhiễu loạn, làm xáo trộn

Ex: During a magnetic storm, the earth's magnetic field is disturbed.

monitor

(verb). GIám sát

Ex: The nurse is monitoring his heart rate and respiration.

supervisor

(noun). người giám sát, người quản lí

Ex: All work is done under the guidance of a supervisor.

surveillance

(noun). giám sát

Ex: The police are keeping the suspects under constant surveillance.

accessible

(adjective). Có thể tiếp cận, truy cập được

Ex: Ex: The beach should be accessible to everyone.

internal

(adjective). bên trong

Ex: The company has launched an internal investigation into the claims.

customer

(noun). khách hàng

Ex: They know me—I'm a regular customer.

item

(noun). món hàng

Ex: There are plenty of vegetarian items on the menu.

consumption

(noun). sự tiêu thụ

Ex: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.

enable

(verb). Cho phép

Ex: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.

enthusiasm

(noun). sự hào hứng, sự hăng hái

Ex: The news was greeted with a lack of enthusiasm by those at the meeting.

innovation

(noun). Đổi mới, cải tiến

Ex: The company is very interested in product design and innovation.

notice

(verb). chú ý, nhận thấy

Ex: The first thing I noticed about him was his eyes.

profitable

(adjective). mang lại nhiều lợi nhuận

Ex: It is usually more profitable to sell direct to the public.

propel

(verb). thúc đẩy

Ex: The film propelled him to international stardom.

propose

(verb). đề xuất, đề nghị

Ex: The government proposed changes to the voting system.

transfer

(verb). chuyển đổi

Ex: My employer wanted to transfer me to another department.

tremendous

(adjective). cực kì to lớn

Ex: A tremendous amount of work has gone into the project.

unprecedented

(adjective). chưa từng có tiền lệ

Ex: There were unprecedented scenes of violence in the city’s main square.

at the mercy of

(adverb). phó mặc cho

Ex: I'm not going to put myself at the mercy of the bank.

distinct

(adjective). khác biệt

Ex: The results of the survey fell into two distinct groups.

feature

(verb). mô tả nét nổi bật của

Ex: The actress was featured on the cover of Time magazine last month.

initially

(adverb). lúc đầu

Ex: Initially, the system worked well.

locate

(verb). đặt vào vị trí

Ex: They located their headquarters in Swindon.

pessimistic

(adjective). bi quan

Ex: I am deeply pessimistic about the future.

roam

(verb). đi lang thang

Ex: The sheep are allowed to roam freely on this land.

mainly

(adverb). chủ yếu

Ex: People come to libraries mainly to borrow books.

abundant

(adjective). nhiều, dồi dào

Ex: Fish are abundant in the lake.

associate

(verb). liên tưởng, liên kết

Ex: Most people immediately associate addictions with drugs, alcohol and cigarettes.

automatic

(adjective). tự động

Ex: My camera has manual and automatic functions.

connect

(verb). liên kết, liên tưởng

Ex: Bad diet is closely connected with many common illnesses.

extensively

(adverb). 1 cách bao quát

Ex: He has written extensively on contemporary art.

legacy

(noun). di sản

Ex: His influence on younger musicians is perhaps his greatest legacy.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

permanently

(adverb). vĩnh viễn

Ex: She had decided to settle permanently in France.

spread

(verb). Dàn trải, lan toả

Ex: The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.

symbolise

(verb). biểu tượng hóa

Ex: The use of light and dark symbolises good and evil.
